info.description: Fugu Max orchestrates Sakana AI's largest pool of open-weights and specialized models (including NVIDIA's Nemotron family) to push the cost-performance Pareto frontier, dynamically finding efficient combinations of expert agents. Uses a fixed model pool; fugu-max currently points to fugu-max-v1.0. Reasoning efforts high and xhigh (default high); max is accepted as an alias of xhigh. Fixed per-token price regardless of context length; built-in web_search and web_fetch are billed separately per call.

zh.description: Fugu Max 编排 Sakana AI 规模最大的开放权重与专用模型池（包括 NVIDIA Nemotron 系列），动态寻找高效的专家智能体组合，推进成本与性能的帕累托前沿。使用固定模型池；fugu-max 目前指向 fugu-max-v1.0。思考档位为 high 与 xhigh（默认 high），max 作为 xhigh 的别名被接受。按 token 固定计价，不随上下文长度变化；内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 按次另计。
